connector.name: QuReDec
connector.registryDescription: Evidence-backed decision briefs with citations - recommendation, confidence, risks, sources.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package quredec-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the advanced-binary-operations account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: QUREDEC_API_KEY
env.description: Per-user API key. Generate one at https://quredec.com/account.

env.name: QUREDEC_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the QuReDec API host. Defaults to https://quredec.com.

env.name: QUREDEC_MOCK
env.description: Set to 1 to run against an in-process mock (no network, no API key required). Development use only.
